fact: UNHCR says that by 31 March 2026, 22,474 individuals and 7,746 births were registered through mobile and continuous registration in Uganda.
UNHCR says it coordinates the Protection Sector, scaling registration and documentation through mobile and continuous registration, with 30,220 new arrivals registered in Q1 2026.

The Office of the Prime Minister says its Department of Refugees receives and documents refugees and issues refugee identity cards, household attestation forms, asylum seeker certificates and conventional travel documents.
NIRA says refugees and asylum seekers in Uganda cannot apply for Ugandan National Identification cards, which are issued only to citizens and legally resident non-citizens.
NIRA says OPM and UNHCR are carrying out a nationwide verification exercise of all registered refugees and asylum seekers.
